Nadia Brooks: incoming ticket #81642 from Skybridge — they got two invoices for July: one with a 15% "early-adopter" discount and one without. both invoices have the same invoice_key but different totals. support says customer was charged the non-discount amount and is upset. cc @Owen
Owen Li: can you share the invoice ids?
Nadia Brooks: inv_20260701_sky_A and inv_20260701_sky_B
Sam Caldwell: quick summary from ledger: A = $2,040.00 (discount applied), B = $2,400.00 (no discount). B arrived later and marked final. customer paid B but sees discount in dashboard for A, confusing reconciliation.
Owen Li: grabbing billing-run logs. looks like feature-flag evaluation for "pricing_experiment_v2" was nondeterministic across the initial run and the retry. our billing runner evaluates flags at runtime instead of using the snapshot.
Sam Caldwell: paste of the run log snippet: ```INFO 2026-07-01T03:59:58Z billing: start invoice acct=skybridge id=acct_881 key=2026-07-01
INFO 2026-07-01T03:59:59Z flags: pricing_experiment_v2=on (eval_time=2026-07-01T03:59:59Z user_segment=beta)
INFO 2026-07-01T04:00:00Z billing: invoice-complete invoice_id=inv_20260701_sky_A lines=[compute:2400.00, experiment-discount:-360.00] total=2040.00
WARN 2026-07-01T04:00:02Z billing: transient error publishing invoice -> retry triggered
INFO 2026-07-01T04:00:03Z flags: pricing_experiment_v2=off (eval_time=2026-07-01T04:00:03Z user_segment=beta)
INFO 2026-07-01T04:00:04Z billing: invoice-complete invoice_id=inv_20260701_sky_B lines=[compute:2400.00] total=2400.00
WARN 2026-07-01T04:00:05Z billing: duplicate invoice created invoice_id=inv_20260701_sky_B original=inv_20260701_sky_A```
Leah Ortiz: so the retry path re-evaluated the flag and produced a different result. dedupe currently looks only at invoice_key and doesn't reconcile content differences; it created a second invoice instead of consolidating.
Nadia Brooks: finance — can we credit the $360 difference and reissue a single canonical invoice? customer wants a single final invoice matching their dashboard (i.e., with discount).
Leah Ortiz: finance approves a credit for $360 and reissue as long as we document the change and include audit trail. also ask legal about mentioning "pricing experiment" in customer comms; probably we should avoid internal jargon and say "billing configuration change during invoice processing".
Owen Li: remediation plan: 1) regenerate invoice from a config snapshot taken at billing-run start (branch: fix/billing-snapshot-flags), 2) patch dedupe to compare line signatures and prefer the invoice with discount if both share same payment state (PR: billing/merge-same-key), 3) add test stubbing feature-flag service and forcing different evaluations across retry. I'll open PRs and run dry-run.
Sam Caldwell: dry-run preview (redacted ids): ```invoice_preview: {account: acct_881, period: 2026-07-01..2026-07-31, lines: [compute: $2400.00, experiment-discount: -$360.00], total: $2040.00}``` looks correct and matches dashboard.
Nadia Brooks: I'll send the customer the replacement invoice + $360 credit note and a short apology. Leah, please add audit entry and confirm wording with legal before send.
Leah Ortiz: done. adding audit note: "Replaced duplicate invoice due to non-deterministic pricing flag during billing run; credit issued; invoice regenerated from start-of-run config snapshot."
BillingBot: Automated: created follow-up TASK-11234 assigned to @Owen Li for patching snapshot logic and dedupe; monitoring enabled for acct_881 for 72h for duplicate-key events.
Owen Li: I'll monitor the next two nightly runs and report back. tagging @BillingBot to watch for any more same-key conflicts. :eyes:
BillingBot: monitoring active for acct_881 for 72 hours. will alert #finance and #eng-billing on duplicates or zero-line invoices.
